construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

CTCAC CA-26-515: Block 5 Apartments, located at 10123 North Wolfe Road in Cupertino on a 1.91 acre site, requested and is being recommended for a reservation of $9,287,656 in annual federal tax credits and $53,597,685 of tax- exempt bond cap to finance the new construction of 234 units of housing, consisting of 232 restricted rental units and 2 unrestricted manager's units. Recorded as a note because this funding covers Block 5 Apartments (234 units), which may be one component of this record.

State report 2025 application row M-2025-001 lists APNs 316-20-121 and 316-20-120; 316-20-120 is not in the county parcel dataset. The 2018 rows (DP-2018-02) list APNs 316-20-080, -081, -094, -095, -099, -100, -101, -103, -104, -105, -106 and -107.

City project page: office about 1.97 million sq ft (2018), 1.95 million (second modification, 2023), 1.475 million (third modification, 2025); retail about 226,000 sq ft (second modification) and 226,600 sq ft (third modification). Original 2018 approval was 2,402 units.

CTCAC CA-26-515 Block 5 Apartments: 65 studio, 48 one-bedroom, 61 two-bedroom and 60 three-bedroom units; 24 units at 30% AMI, 46 at 50%, 68 at 60%, 94 at 70%; total development cost $200,035,551 at application; construction expected November 2026 to March 2029. Construction sources: Chase tax-exempt $53,597,685, Chase taxable $57,423,034, Platinum Valley B residential $48,249,556 and commercial $9,639,667, tax credit equity $7,355,886. Permanent sources: Chase tax-exempt $48,787,800, Platinum Valley B $48,249,556 and $9,639,667, deferred developer fee $14,754,227, GP equity $2,705,446, tax credit equity $75,898,855. Bond issuer California Municipal Finance Authority. CTCAC says the site's parcel and APN are not yet finalized and are part of a larger site.

San Jose Spotlight, Dec. 2025: revised plan delivered Nov. 26, 2025 keeps 2,669 homes on 50 acres, cuts affordable homes from 890 to 356 and office from 2 million to 1.5 million sq ft; first phase (Town Center West) is housing and retail on eight blocks along Stevens Creek Boulevard, with first occupancy expected in 2028.

SV@Home, Feb. 2026: the first residential building, Town Square West, is 232 affordable homes by Sand Hill Property Company and Eden Housing, half of them two- and three-bedroom units, most at or below 50% AMI; a construction permit application has been submitted.
